scope.statement: Check the finite radial replacements and path examples in the November 17 research note.
scope.domain: All rim pairs at odd sizes 33, 65, 129 and 257, plus the occupied-source and refilled-cut fixtures specified in check.py.
scope.limitations: The finite cases do not establish the general path arguments or the existence of a strict competitor for every sufficiently large triangle-free minimizer.

result: The checker bounds every rim pair and verifies all 21 pairs in each of the two planar fixtures.
remaining_questions: Can the path constraints force an exact unit triangle or a feasible improvement for every sufficiently large triangle-free global minimizer?
